props.name: renderVisual
props.description: Draws the visual for a step. Called with the active step in the sticky layout, and once per step when stacked.

props.name: visualSide
props.description: Which side the sticky visual sits on.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Called when a different step becomes active.

props.name: stickyTop
props.description: Distance from the top of the viewport the visual sticks at — clear a fixed header here.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the whole story.
